_notes.surface: DSH headless one-shot conversation; not a subagent and not a Web subagent session
_notes.fresh_session: each invocation gets a new session-<uuid>; the adapter never passes --session-id
_notes.prompt: the two-line dispatch text is sent verbatim on stdin; the headless profile adds only its ordinary system persona/cwd suffix
_notes.cwd: cli_suite.py starts each process with cwd set to its external run workdir
_notes.sandbox: the stock DSH headless/base filesystem sandbox remains active; the overlay changes only the model route
_notes.evidence: --json emits a session identity, tool activity, final result, and exit status to stdout.log/stderr.log
_notes.credential: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY is resolved through the DSH credential seam; no secret is stored in this adapter
